Why Study in United States?

Country-specific advantages for academic and career progression

World Academic Leadership

Consistently dominates global university rankings with cutting-edge laboratories and Nobel laureate faculty.

3-Year STEM OPT

Graduates of STEM programs can work in the US for up to 36 months on Optional Practical Training (OPT).

Graduate Assistantships

Master's and PhD students can receive Teaching or Research Assistantships (TA/RA) covering full tuition plus monthly stipends.

Flexible Curriculum

US universities allow you to customize your majors, minors, and interdisciplinary concentrations.

United States Student Visa Process

Official step-by-step roadmap from university offer to visa stamp

1

Apply & Receive Form I-20

Gain admission and receive official Certificate of Eligibility (Form I-20).

2

Pay SEVIS I-901 Fee ($350)

Pay mandatory Student and Exchange Visitor Information System fee.

3

Complete Form DS-160 Online

Fill out Nonimmigrant Visa Application form accurately.

4

Schedule US Embassy Interview

Pay visa application fee ($185) and book appointment at US Embassy Dhaka.

5

F-1 Visa Interview

Attend in-person visa interview with ALO mock interview preparation.

Frequently Asked Questions

Country-specific answers verified by ALO Education compliance

What is Form I-20 in US university admissions?

Form I-20 is the official Certificate of Eligibility issued by a SEVP-certified US university, showing your enrollment details and cost of attendance.

What is the SEVIS fee for F-1 visa?

The SEVIS I-901 fee is a mandatory $350 USD government fee paid before scheduling your visa interview at the US Embassy.

What is STEM OPT in the USA?

STEM OPT allows graduates with Science, Technology, Engineering, or Math degrees to extend their post-graduation work authorization for up to 36 months.

Is SAT or GRE mandatory for US universities?

Many US universities are currently test-optional or test-blind for undergraduate (SAT) and graduate (GRE/GMAT) programs.

Can I study in the USA with Duolingo English Test (DET)?

Yes, over 2,000 US universities accept Duolingo English Test scores (typically 105 to 125).

What questions are asked in the US Embassy F-1 interview?

Why this university? Why this program? Who is sponsoring you? What are your career plans after graduation in Bangladesh?

How much bank balance is required on the I-20?

You must demonstrate liquid funds covering 1 full academic year of tuition and living expenses as specified in Section 7 of your Form I-20.

What are Graduate Assistantships (TA/RA)?

Teaching Assistantships (TA) and Research Assistantships (RA) provide graduate students with full tuition waivers and monthly stipends in exchange for campus work.

Can international students work off-campus in the USA?

F-1 students can work on-campus up to 20 hours/week. Off-campus work requires Curricular Practical Training (CPT) authorization.

What is Curricular Practical Training (CPT)?

CPT allows F-1 students to participate in paid off-campus internships that are an integral part of their degree program.

What is the DS-160 application?

The DS-160 is the online Nonimmigrant Visa Application submitted to the US Department of State before booking an embassy interview.

When are the main intakes in the USA?

Fall (August/September) is the primary and largest intake; Spring (January) is the secondary intake.

Can I apply to US universities with an HSC degree from Bangladesh?

Yes, HSC graduates with GPA 3.5+ can apply for 4-year Bachelor's degree programs across the USA.

What is a Community College 2+2 pathway?

Students complete the first 2 years at an affordable community college to earn an Associate Degree, then transfer to a 4-year university for their Bachelor's.

Can relatives in the USA sponsor my education?

Yes, family members or sponsors in the USA can provide Form I-134 along with tax transcripts (W-2 / 1040) and bank letters.

What is 214(b) visa refusal in US Embassy?

Section 214(b) means the consular officer determined you did not sufficiently demonstrate nonimmigrant intent or strong ties to Bangladesh.

How does ALO Education prepare students for the US Embassy interview?

ALO Education conducts comprehensive 1-on-1 mock interviews, reviewing your DS-160, financial documentation, and verbal communication.

Can I bring my spouse on an F-2 visa?

Yes, spouses of F-1 students can accompany them on an F-2 visa, though F-2 visa holders are not permitted to work.

Are international student scholarships available in the USA?

Yes, US universities offer generous merit scholarships ranging from $5,000 to $25,000 per year automatically upon admission review.

Does ALO Education charge any fees for US university admissions?

No, ALO Education provides free university selection, application support, I-20 processing, and interview preparation.
